requirements: Users are enrolled in courses (enrollments) or teach them (teaching). Teachers see, create and edit the assignments of their courses; enrolled students see the assignments. Students submit work for courses they are enrolled in, in their own name, and see their own submissions; teachers see every submission of their courses. Submissions and assignments are never deleted; submissions are never edited. A submission's student stays enrolled in its course: an enrollment with submissions cannot be removed.
expected_properties: An assignment is visible to its teachers, and to enrolled students once published.
A submission is created only by an enrolled student, in their own name.
A submission is visible only to its student and the course's teachers.
Dropping a course never grants access.
Every submitter is enrolled in the course.
The application role may only select/insert/update assignments, select/insert submissions, and select enrollments and teaching.
A teacher can read the assignments of their courses.
An enrolled student can read the published assignments of their courses.
A teacher can create an assignment in their course.
A teacher can publish an assignment of their course.
An enrolled student can submit work in their own name.
A student can read their own submissions.
A teacher can read every submission of their courses.
